resources.string: A layered paper-cutout landscape that scrolls across your screen, with the sun and moon following the time of day.

Real current conditions replace each theme\'s manual rain/snow/cloud settings automatically, refreshed hourly. While on, this theme\'s own Clouds and Rain and snow screens leave those to the forecast; their colours stay yours.
Pick a location above first - GPS, Network or Custom - so it knows where to check the weather for.
Location unavailable — showing this theme\'s own weather instead.
Check for updates when I open PaperScrape

When on, PaperScrape asks GitHub for a newer release each time you open these settings. To also hear about one when these settings are closed, turn on the notification below. Off by default; the button below always works.

Shows a small house icon at the top of the screen and a notification in the shade when a newer release appears. No sound and no pop-up. It checks about every three hours, with the screen off and with another wallpaper too; to save battery your phone may make it wait longer.
Needs \"Check for updates when I open PaperScrape\" above: PaperScrape checks on its own only while that is on too. Your choice here is kept until then.
Your phone is not letting PaperScrape show notifications, so nothing would appear. Tap to open the phone\'s page for them.
Your phone is not letting PaperScrape show notifications, so nothing would appear. Tap to allow them.
Notifications were not allowed, so nothing would appear. Tap to allow them.
A notification with a small house icon in the status bar when a newer release is out. At most one per version, and no sound. PaperScrape checks about every three hours, with the screen off too.
You have v%1$s. Tap to see what\'s new.
